getRoomListing(uint256).notice: Current listing for a room. `seller` is non-zero only while the listing is still honourable (room active and seller still the sub-owner).

userdoc.notice: Native ETH marketplace for in-game (active) rooms. UX / popup rationale: - `listRoom` / `cancelRoomListing` are in-game actions routed through   Player.callAsCharacter, so the delegate burner signs them and they add NO   wallet popup — consistent with movement and the rest of gameplay. - `buyListedRoom` moves real ETH, so it is a direct, payable call from the   buyer's main wallet: one deliberate signature, outside the movement loop.   That is the single intentional popup the player opts into when buying. Economics: the contract keeps a commission (basis points, hard-capped) in ETH for the marketplace treasury; the remainder goes to the seller. ETH only — no token is involved anywhere in this flow.
